description: Mechanically check one public image URL for a segment, without an LLM and without judging relevance (the agent, who sees the image, decides relevance). Returns exactly one code: ok, blocked_403 (the host blocked the SSRF-safe download — retry with upload_media bytes fetched on your own machine), not_image, too_small, too_large, timeout, or face_detected. No fake User-Agent or Referer is sent to bypass hotlink blocks, and private addresses are never fetched. The URL never appears in the output.

url.description: Public image URL to check mechanically (no LLM, no relevance judgement).

name: check_media
